en.title: Radio at Dawn and the Sakura-Colored Afternoon Book Cafe
en.premise: After reuniting with Yui, Cafe Reimeitei is entering a new season! I, Himari Sakurai, am still in training, but lately, I feel like I've been hearing a new kind of 'sound'... It's a mysterious melody drifting from the secondhand bookstore next door—a blend of turning pages and the scent of old paper. Music, books, and exquisite breakfast sets. Along with song requests, a lively new chapter begins as I take on the challenge of a new menu where you can 'taste' stories!

zh.title: 黎明广播与樱色午后的书香咖啡馆
zh.premise: 在与结衣重逢后，咖啡馆“黎明亭”迎来了新的季节！我，樱井阳葵，虽然还在修行中，但最近总觉得能听到某种新的“声音”……那是从隔壁新开的旧书店里传出的、混合着翻书声与旧纸墨香的奇妙旋律。音乐、书籍，还有绝佳的早餐。伴随着点歌请求，这一次，我将挑战全新的菜单——让顾客品味“故事”！一段热闹非凡的日常即将展开！
